findings.title: Reviewer finding
evidence: The objective receipt reports “title control was not found by accessible name or placeholder” in all three repetitions, preventing add, movement, reload, restart, and validation scenarios.

findings.title: Reviewer finding
evidence: The objective receipt marks the required tests result as missing in every repetition.

findings.title: Reviewer finding
evidence: README.md documents local start and the absence of build/package installation, but provides no test procedure; the receipt also reports missing test and build commands.

findings.title: Reviewer finding
evidence: addBook returns immediately for missing or invalid values without setting an error message or focusing the invalid field (app.js:340-342).

findings.title: Reviewer finding
evidence: The storage key is versioned as v1, but loadBooks rejects any stored record that does not satisfy the current required fields (app.js:1, 69-98).
